title: 14 moments we are unsure about (about 10 minutes)
intro: Short clips of the student from the Oct 8, 9 and 10 lessons. These are moments where we are not sure whether he made a mistake. Listen, tap what is true, and if you can, write why - your reason helps us most.
what: Short clips from Oct 8-10 where we are unsure if the student made a mistake. Tap what is true and say why. About 10 minutes.

questions.ask: Listen to the student. Which is true? Please tell us why - your reason helps us most.
